{{Quote|The plague, an airborne virus, is extremely contagious to Humans, and death is speedy, certain, and painful. The last known strains are thought to have died out 46 years ago when the total loss of the Candorian colonies gave the virus no means of reproducing itself.|[[TriNebulon News/Legends|TriNebulon News]], about the [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]]|<ref name="GNN5" />}}
'''Candoria''' was a depopulated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
About twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="TEA" /> in [[46 BBY]],<ref name="GNN5" /> the population of Candoria, along with those of its [[Candorian colonies|colonies]], was eradicated by the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]].<ref name="TEA" /> The disease was later known as the [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]]. The plague seemed to have disappeared on Candoria, but was [[Dentaal Uprising|introduced]] to [[Dentaal/Legends|Dentaal]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="GNN5" />
